column1: How do I reset my password?
column2: Go to Settings > Security > Reset Password and follow the prompts.

column1: What are your business hours?
column2: We are open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm EST.

column1: How do I contact customer support?
column2: Email support@example.com or call 1-800-555-HELP during business hours.

column1: Where can I track my order?
column2: Visit orders.example.com and enter your order number to see real-time tracking.

column1: How do I cancel my subscription?
column2: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription. Your access continues until the end of the billing period.

column1: Do you offer refunds?
column2: Yes. Request a refund within 30 days of purchase by contacting support.

column1: How do I update my billing information?
column2: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods to add or update your card.

column1: What payment methods do you accept?
column2: We accept Visa

column1: How do I change my email address?
column2: Go to Settings > Account > Email and verify your new email address.

column1: Is there a free trial?
column2: Yes! Sign up for a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

column1: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
column2: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and scan the QR code with your authenticator app.

column1: What is your privacy policy?
column2: Our full privacy policy is available at example.com/privacy.

column1: How do I delete my account?
column2: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

column1: Do you have a mobile app?
column2: Yes! Download our app from the App Store or Google Play Store.

column1: How do I export my data?
column2: Go to Settings > Account > Export Data to download a copy of all your information.

column1: What browsers do you support?
column2: We support the latest versions of Chrome

column1: How do I report a bug?
column2: Email bugs@example.com with a description and screenshots if possible.

column1: Do you offer bulk pricing?
column2: Yes. Contact sales@example.com for pricing on teams of 10 or more.

column1: How do I invite team members?
column2: Go to Settings > Team > Invite Members and enter their email addresses.

column1: What is your uptime guarantee?
column2: We guarantee 99.9% uptime. Check our status page at status.example.com.
